Type.evidence_source: Ten young men, aged 18–30 at the time of their suicide, were studied by analysing in-depth interviews with four to eight key informants for each person, as well as suicide notes. We interviewed 61 individuals who were closely connected to the deceased.

Area.evidence_source: Ten young men, aged 18–30 at the time of their suicide, were studied by analysing in-depth interviews with four to eight key informants for each person, as well as suicide notes. The selection was based on the need to understand the signs that might indicate danger of suicide in the near term (Berman, 2011; Klineberg et al., 2011; Rudd et al., 2006).
